# Unity Game Project - Shaun RC2

## Project Overview
Unity 2022.3.48f1c1 2D game, Universal Render Pipeline, single assembly (`Assembly-CSharp`).

## Critical: Do Not Edit These Files
- `Assembly-CSharp.csproj` — generated by Unity. Edits will be overwritten.
- `Temp/`, `Library/`, `Logs/` — Unity internals, never modify.
- `.vscode/` is in `.gitignore` — local IDE settings are not shared.

## Solution Files
Four `.sln` files exist (`GAL2025-2026.sln`, `GAL2025-2026Main.sln`, `Shaun RC2.sln`, `Shaun-RC2.sln`) — all point to the same `Assembly-CSharp.csproj`. `.vscode/settings.json` uses `Shaun-RC2.sln`.

## Code Organization
- `Assets/RC1 Assets/` — MainCharacter, YX warrier (enemy), camera, attacks, health
- `Assets/雪山前/` — Movement (dash/wall-jump), camera control, story/plot UI, character data
- `Assets/Scenes/` — FT1.unity, 山洞.unity, SampleScene.unity

## Input System (Dual Approach)
- **Old API**: `Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.X)` used directly in many scripts
- **New API**: `keyBindConfig` ScriptableObject (`Assets/RC1 Assets/Script/Essential/`) provides rebindable controls via `isKeyPressed(name)` — used alongside old API, not instead of it

## Physics Quirk
`Movement.cs` sets `Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1/500f` (500 Hz physics) in `Start()` at runtime. When modifying physics code, be aware that `FixedUpdate` runs at this accelerated rate.

## Building
Build via Unity Editor (File > Build Settings). No CLI build or test commands exist. Target: `StandaloneWindows64`.
